subject: Simple switch-status condition
notes: GR1: "The result of the test is true if the switch is set to the specified position corresponding to condition-name-1." (cite.py --check 8.8.4.6.3 OK, General rule 1). Renderer emits ExternalSwitches.Get(name) for an ON-STATUS name and !Get(name) for an OFF-STATUS name; SwitchStore holds per-run-unit state, initial from COBOL_<NAME> env (implementor-defined, absent = off), SET overrides. Probe at 85 and 2023: initial OFF -> S1-ON F, S1-OFF T, S2-ON F/S2-OFF T, S3-OFF T; after SET ON -> S1-ON T, S1-OFF F, NOT S1-ON F, S3-OFF F; PERFORM UNTIL S1-OFF loops once; env COBOL_SWITCH_2=ON flips S2-ON T/S2-OFF F. Both halves (ON name and OFF name, true and false) covered: pb400 (SWON/SWOFF subject true/false) and l1_search_when_condition_forms (SW1-ON false then true).
